name: accessibility-evidence-engine
description: Evidence-based accessibility investigations for Playwright flows.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/ai-fixes packages/schemas packages/playwright packages/observers packages/judges packages/reporter packages/cli
scripts.check: tsc -b --pretty false packages/core packages/ai-fixes packages/schemas packages/playwright packages/observers packages/judges packages/reporter packages/cli
scripts.example:public-site: npm run build && playwright test --config examples/public-site/playwright.config.ts
scripts.plan:public-site: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js plan examples/public-site/scenario.yml
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:playwright
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=60 --test-coverage-branches=60 --test-coverage-functions=75 --test packages/ai-fixes/dist/index.test.js packages/schemas/dist/validator.test.js packages/playwright/dist/index.test.js packages/observers/dist/index.test.js packages/judges/dist/index.test.js packages/reporter/dist/index.test.js packages/cli/dist/config-validation.test.js packages/cli/dist/index.test.js packages/cli/dist/scenario-runner.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test packages/ai-fixes/dist/index.test.js packages/schemas/dist/validator.test.js packages/playwright/dist/index.test.js packages/observers/dist/index.test.js packages/judges/dist/index.test.js packages/reporter/dist/index.test.js packages/cli/dist/config-validation.test.js packages/cli/dist/index.test.js packages/cli/dist/scenario-runner.test.js
